about: Findings of dev/catalogue/load_order.js that are known and not fixed, each with its reason. An entry is { code, script, on, reason }: `code` and `script` as the FAIL line prints them (script = <type>:<path>), `on` = the other script or the global of that line when it names one.
An accepted finding is printed on every run (ACCEPTED). An entry that matches nothing any more fails the check: delete it with the fix.
